title: Garmin Power Meter Left-Right Balance Drift
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:ride
| search balance_delta_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(balance_delta_pct) as avg_balance_delta_pct max(balance_delta_pct) as max_balance_delta_pct by _time bike_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks left-right balance drift over time and breaks it out by bike.
value: Balance drift can point to fatigue, fit issues, or sensor zeroing problems before they become obvious elsewhere.
implementation: Send left-right balance drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of left-right balance drift by bike.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how left-right balance drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
